body.statement: For every active \(j\in J\), \(\rho\in I\), and \(\theta_j\in[0,\pi/2]\), the correlation definition and \(\lvert\kappa_j\rvert\le1\) give \[v_j(\rho,\theta_j)^2=1-\kappa_j^2(1-\rho)\cos^2(\theta_j)\ge\rho\ge\rho_0.\] This is a lower bound for the residual variance in the limiting selected Gaussian experiment; it does not assert a finite-\(n\) covariance bound.
body.justification: Compact holdout support itself prevents degeneration of the Gaussian conditional residual scale.
body.gap: The residual-scale margin is an algebraic consequence of the present square-root path and therefore should not be imposed as an independent positive-definiteness condition.
body.consumer: All Gaussian quantile, branch, and certification bounds can use the declared design constant \(\rho_0\) directly.
